title: Invoice totals are wrong
description: Customers are being charged the wrong amount. A net price of 100 should cost 120 with 20% VAT, and a 10% discount must be applied to the net amount before tax (so 100 with 10% off = 108). The logic is spread across shop/pricing.py and shop/invoice.py.
acceptance_criteria: price_with_tax adds VAT rather than returning only the tax
discount_pct is a percentage applied to the net amount before tax
